dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: I like the decor here. Seems like working in a different environment once in a while can be a good mood-booster.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: Only thing is, once I get into work mode, I'm so focused on what I'm doing that I don't pay much attention to what's going on in the outside world.

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: So if you need me for anything, you'll have get up close and personal to get my attention. Got it?
